Overview: Delivered a real-time market pricing and portfolio valuation platform consolidating multi-source data from Bloomberg and ICE to support Front Office investment decision-making across Equities, Derivatives, and Fixed Income asset classes benchmarking portfolio performance against 
Problem Statement: The existing pricing process relied on manual data collection from multiple market data sources (Bloomberg, ICE), causing delays in portfolio valuation, inefficient Front Office analyst workflows, and limited real-time market visibility across asset classes. 
Led end-to-end Business Analyst responsibilities for a real-time pricing dashboard from requirements gathering through UAT enabling portfolio valuation benchmarking against market peers including JPMC across equity and fixed income instruments.

Overview: Mars Inc.'s global supplier payment lifecycle spanning PO management, shipment tracking, Letter of Credit issuance, and bank settlement was fragmented across enterprise ERP platforms, third-party logistics systems, and banking portals across 15+ countries, with no unified integration 
Problem Statement: No unified integration layer existed between Mars's supply chain and their trade finance workflows. LC issuance required manual bank communication, supplier KYC onboarding was entirely paper-based, and finance teams maintained parallel Excel trackers with zero real-time transaction visibility resulting in payment delays of 3-5 business days, high reconciliation error rates, and significant compliance risk.
